python3 << 'EOF'
import numpy as np

# Data for years 1929-1942 (in billions of nominal dollars)
years = np.array([1929, 1930, 1931, 1932, 1933, 1934, 1935, 1936, 1937, 1938, 1939, 1940, 1941, 1942])
# Individual income tax receipts net of refunds (in thousands of dollars) converted to billions
receipts_thousands = np.array([1095541, 1146845, 833648, 427191, 352573, 419509, 527113, 674416, 1091741, 1286312, 1028834, 982017, 1417655, 3262800])
receipts = receipts_thousands / 1000000  # Convert to billions

print("Data (year, receipts in billions):")
for y, r in zip(years, receipts):
    print(f"  {y}: {r:.6f}")

# OLS Regression: receipts = beta0 + beta1 * year
X = np.column_stack([np.ones(len(years)), years])
beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X, receipts, rcond=None)[0]

beta0, beta1 = beta
print(f"\nOLS Results:")
print(f"  Intercept (beta0): {beta0:.6f}")
print(f"  Slope (beta1): {beta1:.6f}")

# Project to year 2000
year_pred = 2000
projected = beta0 + beta1 * year_pred
print(f"\nProjected receipts for year 2000: {projected:.6f} billions")

# Actual value for FY 2000 (in billions)
actual = (780397 + 358110 - 134046) / 1000  # Convert million to billions
print(f"Actual receipts for FY 2000: {actual:.6f} billions")

# Difference
diff = actual - projected
print(f"\nDifference (actual - projected): {diff:.6f} billions")
print(f"Rounded to nearest tenth: {round(diff, 1)}")
EOF

print(f"  Intercept (beta0): {beta0:.6f}")
